R. Q. 1 فَذْفَذَ He contracted himself (تَقَاصَرَ), to leap, deceiving, or circumventing, (IAar, T, O, K,) or in order to deceive, or circumvent, when leaping; (IAar, T in art. ذف;) said of a man. (IAar, T, O.) ―
-b2- [And accord. to the K, in art. ذف, i. q. تَبَخْتَرَ; like ذَفْذَفَ: but] accord. to IAar, ذَفْذَفَ has this latter meaning, and فَذْفَذَ signifies as expl. above on his authority. (T in art. ذف.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
